ko.theme_desc: 달콤한 유혹에 빠진 인류, 붕어빵의 끈적한 촉수에 속절없이 사로잡히고 있다. 곧 붕어빵 공장에서 강제 노동을 하게 될지도.

scenarios.10y: 붕어빵 군단의 건강 검진을 시작했는데, 죄다 팥 앙금 과다래.
scenarios.20y: 붕어빵 제국 변호사가 됐는데, 붕어빵 판결은 전부 '달콤함' 위반이래.
scenarios.30y: 붕어빵 세상에서 탈출해, 붕어빵을 치료하는 의사가 됐지 뭐야! 붕세권 부활!

en.theme_title: ⚠️ Warning: The Great Fish-Shaped Pastry Assimilation!
en.theme_desc: Humans are falling prey to the delicious allure of fish-shaped pastries, ensnared by their sticky embrace. Forced labor in the pastry factories looms.

scenarios.10y: Started giving health check-ups to the Fish-Shaped Bun army, and everyone has a sugar rush.
scenarios.20y: Became a lawyer for the Fish-Shaped Bun empire, and all the rulings are about 'excess sweetness'.
scenarios.30y: I escaped the Fish-Shaped Bun world and became a doctor who treats Fish-Shaped Buns! Fish-Shaped Bun utopia is back!
